==English==

===Pronunciation===
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-cardinal number.wav|a=Southern England}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# A number used to denote [[quantity]]; a [[counting number]]; a [[cardinal]].
#: {{ux|en|The smallest '''cardinal numbers''' are 0, 1, 2, and 3.}}
#: {{ux|en|The '''cardinal number''' “three” can be represented as “3” or “three”.}}
# {{lb|en|mathematics}} A generalized kind of [[number]] used to denote the size of a [[set]], including [[infinite]] sets.
# {{lb|en|grammar}} A word that expresses a [[countable]] [[quantity]]; a [[cardinal numeral]].
#: {{ux|en|“Three” is a '''cardinal number''', while “third” is an ordinal number.}}

====Synonyms====
* {{sense|number}} {{l|en|cardinal}}
* {{sense|word}} {{l|en|cardinal numeral}}

====Coordinate terms====
* {{sense|grammar}} {{l|en|distributive number}}, {{l|en|multiplier}}, {{l|en|ordinal number}}
